_board_change_note: 2026-09-17: the human changed the operational board from charuco_7x7_190mm to this 7 x 5 board on A4 landscape (7 squares along the 297 mm side, 5 along the 210 mm side, 38 mm squares, marker = 22/30 of a square as on the earlier prints). The print PDF named in print_pdf_ref does not exist yet: tools/make_square_board.py only builds square 190 mm boards on A4 portrait.
_position_frame_note: Every *_position_mm and *_center_mm value in this file is in the SHEET frame: origin at the printed sheet's origin_corner, +X right along a row, +Y down along a column, +Z into the board. The pipeline's board frame is a different frame; tomato3d/calib/board.py::sheet_to_board_mm is the only conversion.
_scale_block_note: Cell A1 is a marker-free (black) square on this board - all four corner cells are (checked with OpenCV's generated 7 x 5 pattern) - so the block covers no marker. scale_block_nominal_height_mm stays null until the physical block is measured with a caliper.
_color_chart_note: The colour chart sits on the turntable beside the board, not on it, so it cannot occlude markers. Its pose is not solved; it is used for colour correction only.
_spare_variant_note: build/charuco_board_7x7_190mm_A4.pdf (27.14 mm cells) and build/charuco_board_5x5_190mm_A4.pdf (38 mm cells) are earlier prints and are NOT the operational board. Marker IDs overlap between all three variants, so a session's board is known only from its manifest.
